en.tagline: Manage Stripe customers, billing and payments via Maton CLI
en.summary: This skill lets an agent call the Stripe API through the Maton CLI. It covers customers, subscriptions, invoices, products, prices, and payments. The Stripe credential stays in the Maton gateway, and the agent only uses your own Maton login.
problem: Working with Stripe usually means handling a Stripe secret key or OAuth token in local tooling. Every write to billing or payment data also needs a careful check of the account, object IDs, and amounts.

With this skill, requests go through the `maton` CLI and the gateway injects the Stripe OAuth token server-side. Reads and lists are the default. Each write or new connection needs your approval, shown with the endpoint, target object, IDs, amounts, and whether it is test or live mode.
fit: Looking up Stripe customers, subscriptions, invoices, or payment records
Creating or updating products, prices, customers, or invoices after you approve each change
Running a Stripe read on a schedule through a hosted function you wrote and approved
unfit: Calls to other third-party apps, which belong to the api-gateway skill
Stripe areas outside the documented list, such as payouts, Connect, disputes, or API keys, unless you name the exact endpoint and approve it
steps: Run `maton login` once to sign in with your own Maton account.
Create or pick a Stripe connection, using the least-privileged account and scopes you have, and confirm the connection ID before each request.
Run read and list calls first, such as `maton stripe customer list -L 5`.
For any write, review the exact endpoint, object IDs, amounts, and test or live mode, then approve it before it runs.
Use `--connection {connection_id}` when you have more than one Stripe connection, so each request reaches the intended account.
If you want automation, a hosted function and a trigger can run an approved Stripe read on a schedule or on a Stripe event.

zh.tagline: 通过 Maton CLI 管理 Stripe 账户
zh.summary: 该技能让智能体通过 Maton CLI 调用 Stripe API，涵盖客户、订阅、发票、产品、价格和支付。Stripe 凭据保留在 Maton 网关中，智能体只使用你自己的 Maton 登录身份。
problem: 通常，使用 Stripe 需要在本地工具中处理 Stripe 密钥或 OAuth 令牌。每次修改账单或支付数据前，还要仔细核对账户、对象 ID 和金额。
使用该技能后，请求经由 `maton` CLI 发出，网关在服务端注入 Stripe OAuth 令牌。默认只做读取和列表查询。每次写入或新建连接都需要你批准，批准时会显示端点、目标对象、ID、金额，以及是测试模式还是正式模式。
fit: 查询 Stripe 客户、订阅、发票或支付记录
在你批准每项改动后，创建或更新产品、价格、客户或发票
通过你编写并批准的托管函数，定时运行 Stripe 读取操作
unfit: 调用其他第三方应用，这类任务属于 api-gateway 技能
文档列表之外的 Stripe 功能，如打款、Connect、争议或 API 密钥，除非你指定具体端点并批准
steps: 运行一次 `maton login`，用你自己的 Maton 账户登录。
创建或选择一个 Stripe 连接，使用你拥有的最小权限账户和授权范围，每次请求前确认连接 ID。
先执行读取和列表操作，例如 `maton stripe customer list -L 5`。
对任何写入操作，先核对具体端点、对象 ID、金额以及测试或正式模式，获得批准后再执行。
如果有多个 Stripe 连接，使用 `--connection {connection_id}` 指定目标，确保请求发往正确的账户。
如需自动化，可用托管函数和触发器，定时运行或在 Stripe 事件发生时运行已批准的 Stripe 读取操作。
